notes.title: 「A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism - Vistas Abound」now on sale!
notes.notes:
※This DLC is only available in Japan※

For one week from today, March 3rd, "A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism - Vistas Abound" will be on sale for 10% off! Please take this opportunity to purchase the game.

[b]Bundle[/b] 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30042

[b]DLC only[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168690/

[h3][u]About "A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism - Vistas Abound"[/u][/h3]

The "A Train" x "Sightseeing" will "expand" even further!
"A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism" has been upgraded to "Vistas Abound" and now you can play through this title with even more possibilities!

As the president of a railroad company, the player extends the tracks, develops the infrastructure, and transports many people. By doing so, the city grows, and the company's revenue increases.

It is up to you to decide how to develop the city as the company grows.
Why don't you create the future of the city with "A-Train"?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386106/3a1cd8f5b97d5b26a71fca511d33d71e9dbcecf7.jpg[/img]

There are three key points of the "Vistas Abound."

With the addition of actual sightseeing trains, bullet trains, etc. from all over Japan, [b]"Railroad Cars" will expand!!! [/b]

New sightseeing buildings, stalls, signs that represent the bustle of the city, and [b] "Railroad Museum," where you can display your favorite trains, will [b]expand [b]city development[/b]! [/b]

You can share your original train cars or just the topography of your city online, and even process the scenery of your city. You can also [b]share your original train cars, share only the terrain of your city online, and [b]process the scenery of your city with the "Photo Mode" to [b]expand the circle of the A train! [/b]

[u][h3]"Kohma's First Look at a Game in Action"[/h3][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386106/1bb02704ed27b8f2220196d6fb4f01f26f9dc6ba.png[/img]

"A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism - Vistas Abound" will be introduced on the YouTube channel of development simulation game player Kohma.
※This stream will also be mirror streamed on Steam.

Date and Time ： Friday, March 3rd, from 9:00 p.m. (JST)
Youtube page ：https://youtube.com/live/gliuGNmsR44
Kohma Twitter ：https://twitter.com/kohma_game

notes.title: "A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism" is arriving!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that the long-awaited "A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism" is arriving on Steam on December 7th! (PT) Wishlist it right now so you won't miss it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685460/ATrain_All_Aboard_Tourism/

[h2]Become the president of a railroad company![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10552304/f5932b53c353167016c0ba5ee427702c423204ac.gif[/img]

[b]A-Train: All Aboard Tourism[/b] is a business simulation game in which you use the railroad to help towns develop.
In the world of A-Train, people gather around stations, gradually developing the surrounding town.
As president of your very own railroad company, you are free to build stations and lay train lines as you see fit.
What kind of railroad will you create? How will you develop the town? All these choices and more are yours to make.

However, as company president, your job is about more than just developing the transportation network.
It's important that you decorate your town by establishing subsidiaries and advertise your company to increase your brand power.

[h2]Tourism-based urban planning[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10552304/c8515c88ab51d953d978ff73e2b57c3384c3dedc.png[/img]

In each town, you will find a variety of tourist attractions, from idyllic hot spring districts to ancient historical castles.
There are many tourists who would love to visit these locations at least once.
However, whether these locations ever reach their full potential depends entirely on your skill.
If a destination is difficult to reach, it will receive few visitors, regardless of how stunning its sights may be.
Use the railroad, bus lines, and even ferries to envision and enable enjoyable holidays.
Your success will surely be reflected in the number of tourists flocking to your town.

[h2]All aboard! Tourism is a one-way ticket to urban planning![/h2]


Any town you can envision is yours to create!
Do you want to see a highly developed metropolis? Perhaps a quiet town, tucked away in the shadow of its beautiful tourist attractions? How about a bustling city with a highly efficient transportation network?
You decide the town's future. This story is yours, told with the help of your friends and associates.
Now, it's time to get started on tourism planning and begin working towards your ideal city!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10552304/ee71de84af7f37985b560098af2fbb7384e2346c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10552304/942b324f6f24003775f14733f3381458da159e59.png[/img]

notes.title: A-Train 9 is Live!
notes.notes:
[b]A-Train 9 is now live on Steam![/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/285400

We're also setting up an official forum for A-Train. Feel free to join us!

http://forums.railwaysims.com/

We'll be conducting some giveaways and contests, as well as plenty of awesome discussions, in the coming weeks. First up, we'll be holding an Introductions Giveaway!

To be eligable for a free Steam key of A-Train 9, all you have to do is post an introduction of yourself (either here or in another topic, as long as it's in this thread). Share a little bit about yourself, what got you into A-Train, or anything else that comes to mind!

The giveaway will be completely random and will take place on June 1. If you end up already having a copy of A-Train 9, we'll hook you up with another prize :)

You can visit our official site here: http://www.railwaysims.com/
